nodes.label: onnx.in.proto
nodes.desc: NodeProto (L223), ModelProto (L449), GraphProto (L564), TensorProto (L607): the messages that define what an ONNX model is.

nodes.label: helper.py
nodes.desc: make_node (L136), make_graph (L203), make_model (L297) compose valid protos from Python data.

nodes.label: numpy_helper.py
nodes.desc: to_array (L234) and from_array (L408) convert tensors both ways, respecting raw_data vs typed fields.

nodes.label: serialization.py
nodes.desc: _ProtobufSerializer (L94) and friends register into a _Registry (L51) so load/save pick the format from file content.

nodes.label: checker.py
nodes.desc: check_model (L120) delegates to the pybind-exported C++ checker with Python-friendly errors.

nodes.label: checker.cc
nodes.desc: check_value_info (L163), check_tensor (L349), and check_model (L1508) enforce IR cleanliness plus function call cycle detection (L1343).

nodes.label: schema.cc
nodes.desc: OpSchemaRegistry::Instance (L110) owns domain/version maps; GetSchema (L908) resolves a node's op at its opset.

nodes.label: tensor/defs.cc
nodes.desc: ONNX_OPERATOR_SET_SCHEMA blocks (L22 onward) declare each op's inputs, outputs, constraints, and shape rules.

nodes.label: shape_inference.cc
nodes.desc: propagateElemTypeFromInputToOutput (L97) and mergeInShapeInfo (L143) are the composable building blocks op schemas reuse.

nodes.label: version_converter.py
nodes.desc: convert_version (L17) walks the C++ up/down converter (L39) to move models between opset versions.

nodes.label: ReferenceEvaluator
nodes.desc: class ReferenceEvaluator (L28) precompiles a model into Python op handlers; run (L560) executes them with NumPy.

nodes.label: op_run.py
nodes.desc: The OpRun base class plus type bridges; _build_schemas (L47) snapshots C++ schemas for Python-side checks.

nodes.label: ops/_op_list.py
nodes.desc: Imports every implemented op class (L283 onward) and exposes the registry the evaluator consults.

nodes.label: Backend base
nodes.desc: BackendRep (L58) and Backend (L69): prepare (L91), run_model (L102), run_node (L110) form the runtime contract.

nodes.label: test Runner
nodes.desc: Runner (L61) assembles unittest suites (test_suite L159) from thousands of generated node and model cases.

nodes.label: node test cases
nodes.desc: Per-op test scripts define inputs/outputs; the runner materializes them into protobuf test data.
